types1:Item.types1:Name: SearchPerson_Process
types1:Item.types1:Description: Build guide 4.6. Searches CPD for an existing person by Ext Id / VINCI ID.

process.name: SearchPerson_Process
process.description: Wraps CPD API 3.2.1 (Search Person, Ext Id / VINCI ID match per project decision). Called once per employee by ProcessOneEmployee_Process (build guide 4.15 step 3), immediately before the Create/Update decision (build guide 4.7).

parameter.description: Dayforce EmployeeNumber, used as the CPD external identifier
parameter.name: in_EmployeeNumber

field.description: True if SearchPersonByExtId returned a matching person
field.name: out_PersonFound

field.description: Existing VINCI ID, populated only when out_PersonFound=true
field.name: out_personVinciId

field.description: contractId of the person's active contract, populated only when out_PersonFound=true
field.name: out_ExistingContractId

field.description: Person's existing CPD phone entries, as untyped XML, if the search response includes them
field.name: out_ExistingPhones

process.notes: Hand-authored against the CPD-Dayforce Functional Design & API Build Guide v1.0 and verified against real IICS Process Designer 11 exports - see README_IICS_BUILD_NOTES.md. KNOWN LIMITATION carried over from the design doc (section 3.2.1): Ext Id/VINCI ID matching only finds a person once already assigned by a prior successful run, so it cannot on its own distinguish a genuine new hire from one whose CPD assignment failed/hasn't propagated yet. out_PersonFound=false is therefore treated as "create" by ProcessOneEmployee_Process's decision step per the functional scenarios; this is a design tradeoff already accepted when choosing this match criteria over name+DOB, not a bug in this sub-process. The sample GetPersons.xml response used to build this mapping did not include a phoneNumber list, so out_ExistingPhones will come back empty even for persons with phones on file - confirm against a live CPD test call whether phones are returned inline or need a separate call before the phone-reconciliation logic (build guide 4.11) is finalized. The search response's root element wraps each match under an auto-numbered child (e.g. root/_1, root/_2 per the sample) rather than a fixed element name, consistent with a JSON array being converted to XML - the XQuery below is written generically against root/* to tolerate this.

service.title: Search CPD person by ext id
